column3: MT 36:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The Hebrew reads “transgression speaks to the wicked within my heart”; NKJV renders “An oracle within my heart concerning the transgression of the wicked.”
The second line is difficult; NKJV renders “When he finds out his iniquity and when he hates.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountains of God” is rendered “the great mountains.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִדֶּשֶׁן (“the fatness”) is rendered “the fullness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make me wander” is rendered “drive me away.”
